messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable 3D mobile MOBA inspired by Mobile Legends, designed for phone/tablet play in the browser.

## Requirements
- 3D MOBA gameplay with arena, hero, minions, towers, and objective-based victory.
- Mobile-friendly controls and responsive layout for phone/tablet.
- No clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and proceed.
- Focus on a complete playable prototype rather than a copyrighted asset clone.

## Decisions
- Chose a single-page browser game using Three.js to keep the build runnable quickly in this repo.
- Designed an original “Mythic Rift” arena with simplified MOBA mechanics instead of recreating an exact Mobile Legends clone.
- Added keyboard and touch controls so the game works on both desktop and mobile screens.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built a standalone browser game prototype in `index.html`.
- Added 3D arena, hero model, minions, towers, core objective, score/timer HUD, and match overlays.
- Implemented basic combat, projectile attacks, abilities (Q/W/E), level-up flow, win/lose states, joystick controls, and responsive HUD styling.
- Included start/restart UI, pause/mute controls, and mobile-safe layout.

### Active
- Verify gameplay loop and runtime behavior in browser.
- Tune combat balance, map flow, and mobile usability.
- Resolve any rendering, interaction, or logic issues found during testing.

### Blocked
- Browser verification and gameplay tuning are still needed before claiming the build is fully stable or complete.

## Next Move
1. Run the game in a browser and verify the 3D scene renders without errors.
2. Fix any runtime or control issues found during playtesting.
3. Tune lane pressure, hero damage, ability costs, and win/lose flow for better MOBA feel.
4. Finalize polish and mobile responsiveness, then capture a final check screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: main game and all gameplay logic/UI for the prototype.

## Important Context
- Current prototype is a single-file Three.js build in `index.html`; no separate assets or engine project exists yet.
- The game is intentionally an original MOBA-inspired prototype rather than a near-copy of Mobile Legends assets or branding.
- No git status / commit state was tracked in the summary above.
